description: TRAIN-FRONT-FIRST (Daniel 09/11 10:48 BRT): the merge train. With delivery.judge infra, a delivery joins its base branch's queue in the port when it starts; only the front lands, the others check and wait for the front's landed/left event (long poll on the port), and a front that lands moves the base: the next re-merges and re-judges only if its diff conflicts or the changed files reach its checks. false: the delivery lands as before, without the queue.
